L1.description: Catalunya: From today, and until October 30th, the connection halls between both plattforms at L1, and the ones connecting both plattforma al L3 at Catalunya station, are closed due to improvement works. · Torras i Bages: From 05/08/2026, the access Passeig Santa Coloma / costat muntanya of the Torras i Bages station (L1) is closed for works.

L2.description: Monumental: Until September 29th, approximately, the last section of escalators going up from the Badalona Pompeu Fabra's plattform to the lobby at Monumental station, out of service due to maintenance works.

L3.description: Roquetes: Until 25/10/2026, the escalators from the lobby to the entrance Jaume Pinent, of Roquetes station (L3) temporarily out of service. · Poble Sec: Until, approximately, October 6th, due to works, the Teodor Bonaplata access of Poble Sec station is closed.

L4.description: Verdaguer: Until 01/02/2027, the escalator from the platform direction La Pau to the lobby of the Verdaguer station (L4) temporarily out of service. · Verdaguer: Until 01/02/2027, the escalator from the platform direction Trinitat Nova to the lobby of the Verdaguer station (L4) temporarily out of service.

L5.description: Badal: Until September 17, approximately, the escalator going down from the main lobby to the middle lobby at Badal station, out of order due to improvement works. · Badal: Until September 17, approximately, the escalator going up from the middle lobby to the main lobby at Badal station, out of order due to improvement works.
